intended_object: The canonical R-linear isomorphism H^i(X, 𝒪_X·e) ≅ H^i(X, 𝒪_X) between the sheaf cohomology of the trivial line bundle (the free 𝒪_X-module on one generator) and that of the structure sheaf, for a scheme X over Spec R. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The body applies the library's general construction `cohomologyBaseLinearEquivOfIso`, which turns an isomorphism of sheaves of modules into an R-linear equivalence of their cohomology groups. It applies it to `InvertibleSheaf.trivialObjIsoUnit X`, the isomorphism between the free sheaf on one generator and the monoidal unit (𝒪_X as a module over itself). This is the canonical isomorphism the docstring describes, and the `_apply` and `symm_apply` lemmas confirm it is the map induced on cohomology by that isomorphism and by its inverse. The setting fits: a scheme X over Spec R, with i ranging over ℕ, is exactly what R-linearity of the cohomology needs. Nothing in it is narrower than necessary. Mathlib has no sheaf cohomology of modules on schemes in this form, so there is no counterpart.
